title: CMOS INTEGRATED CIRCUITS I
description: Analysis and design of analog integrated circuits in CMOS technology; current mirrors, gain stages, single-ended operational amplifier, frequency response, and compensation.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ECE 322 and 323*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in ECE 322 and ECE 323.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
